# FLX-3623: a consumer query or view reads a table function, a string or a path

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A table is named by an identifier that resolves to an expose of the bundle or to a view. A table function (read_csv, read_parquet, glob, range, generate_series), a table written as a string or as a path, and a stage or a file reference, are refused, since each would read something that is not a table the bundle declares.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3623
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
